top_choice_rationale: Base editing (deamination of a displaced strand, with TadA evolved to act on DNA) is a defined, quantifiable chemical conversion, independently reproduced and already clinical; pairing it with Crews and Deshaies for induced-proximity degradation, confirmed by many groups through ternary-complex and degradation-kinetics measurements, keeps the prize at three laureates with coherent single-achievement citations. P001 follows because the PROTAC trio is well supported but lacks the base-editing chemistry.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; nucleotide metabolism and replication fidelity are adjacent to DNA editing but there is no specific connection to the proposed laureates
